PhotosStatic.privacyNoticeIntro: This notice explains how guest photos and personal data are handled in Armada Photos. It applies both to guests uploading photos and to people pictured in them.
PhotosStatic.privacyControllerDetails: Tekniska Högskolans Studentkår (THS), organisation number 802005-9153, is the controller of this photo service. Its postal address is Ref: Armada, Drottning Kristinas Väg 15-19, 114 28 Stockholm, Sweden. For questions about personal data or a photo, email
PhotosStatic.privacyGuestPhotoData: Guests supply the photos, which may show identifiable people. The service stores the event, upload and moderation times, status, file size and dimensions for each photo. When automatic checks are enabled, it also stores the content assessment and whether approval was automatic or manual. Guests do not need an account or have to provide their name or email address to upload.
PhotosStatic.privacyImageProcessing: Uploaded images are converted to JPEG files with size limits and image metadata removed. The service stores these processed images and gallery thumbnails rather than the original uploaded file. Technical request data is also processed to deliver and protect the website and measure usage and performance. Event links contain an access token, which is handled when the page is requested.
PhotosStatic.howArePhotosUsedAndShared: How are photos used and shared?
PhotosStatic.privacyPhotoPurposes: Photos are used to let event guests share memories in a moderated gallery. THS may also select approved photos to promote Armada on its website, in marketing materials and on social media.
PhotosStatic.privacyGalleryAccess: Armada moderators can review submitted photos. Only approved photos appear in the event gallery. Anyone with the event link or QR code can view them while the gallery is open; access is not restricted to named or signed-in guests. Please treat the link as shareable. Images are served through time-limited links, but viewers can still save or capture what they see. Administrators can export approved photos as a ZIP archive. Promotional use can make a photo available to a wider audience outside the event.
PhotosStatic.privacyAutomaticChecks: For events with automatic checking enabled, Google Cloud Vision SafeSearch receives a smaller copy to check for potentially explicit content. Photos assessed as clearly low-risk may be approved automatically. Uncertain results and failed checks wait for a moderator. This check does not establish that a photo belongs to the event or that everyone pictured agrees to publication. Contact us if you want a moderator to review a photo.
PhotosStatic.privacyGuestIdentifierPrefix: The service stores a random guest identifier in your browser's local storage under
PhotosStatic.privacyGuestIdentifierDetails: . It is sent with upload and quota requests, and an event-specific protected hash is stored on the server to apply the upload limit. The browser identifier has no automatic expiry in the application; it remains until browser storage is cleared. Clearing it removes the identifier from that browser, not photos already uploaded.
PhotosStatic.privacyRecaptchaPrefix: Google reCAPTCHA Enterprise assesses upload requests to help prevent abuse. Google states that reCAPTCHA sets a necessary cookie named
PhotosStatic.privacyRecaptchaAnalysis: for its risk analysis. See Google's
PhotosStatic.privacyServiceProviders: Vercel hosts the website. Google Cloud runs the photo API and background jobs; Google reCAPTCHA Enterprise assesses uploads for abuse, and Cloud Vision SafeSearch can check image content. Supabase provides the database and private image and export storage. These providers process data involved in delivering their respective services.
PhotosStatic.privacyInternationalTransfers: Processing by providers and their subprocessors may take place outside the EU/EEA. A storage or server location does not mean all processing is confined to that location. The providers publish data processing and international-transfer terms:
PhotosStatic.privacyProviderTerms: . These describe the providers' terms, rather than a service-specific assessment by THS of the transfers and safeguards that apply. Contact THS for questions about these arrangements.
PhotosStatic.privacyEventRetention: Each event has an upload closing time and a gallery closing time. Closing the gallery ends guest access; it does not delete the photos. There is currently no fixed retention period or automatic deletion date for event photos. Unless an administrator deletes them, they remain stored after the event. No fixed deletion date has been set for selected marketing copies or published posts either.
PhotosStatic.privacyRejectedPhotoRetention: Rejected photos are hidden from the gallery immediately and can be restored by a moderator for 24 hours. After that deadline, the cleanup job is scheduled to delete their image files; a limited moderation record may remain until event deletion. Administrator ZIP exports expire after 24 hours. Administrators can also request deletion of an event's photos and exports. This notice does not specify retention periods for provider logs or backups.
PhotosStatic.privacyCopiesOutsideControl: You can ask us to remove a photo and copies used by Armada. Copies saved by viewers or shared by others may remain outside THS's control.
PhotosStatic.privacyOptionalUpload: Uploading is optional. Avoid sharing photos of people who do not want to appear, and do not upload sensitive or inappropriate images. Contact
PhotosStatic.privacyRightsRequests: to ask about a photo, object to its use, or request access, correction, deletion or restriction of processing. You can also ask about data portability where applicable. Which rights apply depends on the circumstances. Include the event and enough detail to identify the photo, without sending extra sensitive information unnecessarily.
PhotosStatic.privacyImyInformation: You can complain to the Swedish Authority for Privacy Protection (IMY). Read IMY's information about
PhotosStatic.privacyContact: For questions about this notice, contact
